hero_description: Find a test session, register online and receive your results and certificates directly in your account.
features_subtitle: A complete platform for candidates and test institutes.
feature_1_description: Browse available test sessions, filter by test type and level.
feature_2_description: Register in a few steps, choose your exams and pay securely via Stripe.
feature_3_description: Receive your summons, certificates and diplomas directly in your candidate area.
feature_4_description: Manage your sessions, track registrations, publish documents and generate invoices.
feature_5_description: View your scores and track your progress for each exam taken.
feature_6_description: Transactions secured by Stripe with automatic invoicing and real-time tracking.
how_it_works_subtitle: In 4 steps, from session search to receiving your documents.
step_1_description: Browse available sessions and select the one that matches your test and location.
step_2_description: Create your account or sign in, select your exams and complete your registration.
step_3_description: Pay your registration fees via Stripe, or choose to pay later.
step_4_description: Find your summons, results and certificates in your candidate area.
audience_1_description: Find a session near you, register online and track your results. Your summons and certificates are available in your personal area.
audience_1_feature_1: Session search by test and location
audience_2_description: Create and manage your sessions, track registrations, publish documents and automatically generate invoices with Stripe Connect payment.
audience_2_feature_4: Invoicing and payment via Stripe Connect
cta_description: Find a session near you and certify your language level in just a few clicks.
